architectureDecisions: D1 — AGENT_TASK_V1.requiredFiles is an optional array of relative POSIX paths. validateAgentTask accepts it when every path is a non-empty relative path without '..'. Omitted or empty means no Oracle work.

D2 — resolveAgentTaskContext(task, { repositoryReader, maxMaterializedBytes }) maps requiredFiles to an EXACT ContextRequirement at snapshot = task.baseRevision, catalog = createSourceCatalog with createExactRepositoryProvider wrapping repositoryReader.readFile({ repositoryRef: task.repositoryRoot, revision: task.baseRevision, path }).

D3 — Consumable projection: prompt prefix beginning exactly 'ExHarness grounded context:' with each file path and a bounded excerpt, plus write-only-into-worktree files at .exharness/context/<path> after the worktree exists and before spawn. The source repository is not written.

D4 — runSupervisedTask calls resolveAgentTaskContext before spawn when requiredFiles is non-empty. UNSATISFIED/PARTIAL-with-required-missing/STALE/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED throws or returns a typed CONTEXT_UNSATISFIED result without starting the tool. READY must pin thrown vs result-status to the delivered AgentTaskStatus enum without widening it silently; research gap if a new status is required.

D5 — Tests: a fixture file at a known revision resolves and appears in the prompt/worktree; a missing path does not spawn (fake CLI record file absent); maxMaterializedBytes: 1 does not spawn; a task without requiredFiles does not import/construct createOracleContextResolver (spy or module-load counter).
D6 — Evidence basis: productization probe hasRequiredFilesField false; delivered facade createOracleContextResolver; BB-089 is a different consumer.
D7 — Living: docs/living/system/agent-tools/state.md and docs/living/system/agent-tools/context.md; do not rewrite Oracle Backend/QA living docs as if BB-089 delivered this.
